Author: Vipin Chandra Dixit
Bench: Vipin Chandra Dixit
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 92
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 18918 of 2022
Applicant :- Jogendra

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Qazi Vakil Ahmad Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Santosh Kumar Singh Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Rejoinder affidavit has been filed by learned counsel for the applicant and affidavit of compliance filed by the learned A.G.A. for the State are taken on record.

Heard Sri Qazi Vakil Ahmad, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State, Sri Santosh Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the opposite party and perused the papers on record.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
The statements of victim were recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. wherein there is severe contradictions in both the statements.

It is further submitted that the victim was medically examined by the medical board in compliance of the order of this Court dated 01.12.2022 and as per report of Medical Board dated 10.12.2022 the age of victim is 18-19 years.
Copy of report of Medical Board is annexed as Annexure no. 1 to the affidavit of compliance filed by learned A.G.A.

As per statement of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. it appears Jogendra vs State Of U.P And 3 Others on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147846974/
1 that she is consenting party and no offence is made out against the applicant.

sentences.text: Lastly it is submitted that the applicant has no criminal history the applicant is in jail since 05.10.2021 and if released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.

Considering the submission of learned counsel for the parties, facts of the case, nature of allegation and period of custody, gravity of offence, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

Let applicant- Jogendra be released on bail in Case Crime No.291 of 2021, under Sections 363, 366,
368, 376(3) I.P.C. and 3/4 (2) POCSO Act, Police Station- Thanabhawan, District Shamli on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned, subject to the following conditions:
(i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence in any manner whatsoever.
(ii) The applicant will abide by the orders of the court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant will not indulge in any unlawful activity.
(iv) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by the court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.
